title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Explore the unique rituals, historic symbols, and student-led traditions that define the Hunter College experience in the heart of Manhattan.

cards.title: The Care of the Future is Mine
cards.subtitle: Official College Motto
cards.notes: Adopted in 1870, this Latin motto appears on the college seal and is a central theme during convocation and commencement ceremonies.
cards.short_summary: The official Latin motto of Hunter College, emphasizing the institution's commitment to education and the future.
cards.evidence_claim: Hunter's motto, Mihi cura futuri (Latin), translates to "The care of the future is mine."
cards.access_notes: Visible on the college seal and official documents across campus.

cards.title: The Purple and Gold Spirit
cards.subtitle: Official School Colors
cards.notes: Students and the Spirit Squad wear these colors to represent Hunter pride at athletic events and the annual Alumni Weekend.
cards.short_summary: The official colors of Hunter College, used in regalia, athletics, and campus branding.
cards.evidence_claim: Hunter's official colors are purple and gold, represented by the Purple and Gold Spirit Squad.
cards.source_title: Purple and Gold Spirit Squad - Hunter College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Colors are prominently displayed during campus events and on official merchandise.

cards.title: The Wistarion Yearbook
cards.subtitle: Named After the Official Flower
cards.notes: Named for the wisteria that once covered the 68th Street building, this yearbook has documented student life for decades.
cards.short_summary: The official yearbook of Hunter College, named after the wisteria flower.
cards.evidence_claim: The yearbook name, Wistarion, stems from Hunter's official flower, the wistaria.
cards.source_title: 80 Years at Hunter: A Look Into The Photo Archives - The Envoy
cards.access_notes: Archived copies are available for viewing at the Hunter College Libraries.

cards.title: The Hunter Hawk
cards.subtitle: Official Athletic Mascot
cards.notes: The Hawk represents Hunter's NCAA Division III teams and is the namesake for student media like Hawk Productions.
cards.short_summary: The official mascot of Hunter College athletics, symbolizing the school's competitive spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: Hunter College's nickname is the Hawks, and the mascot is the Hunter Hawk.
cards.source_title: Hall of Fame - Hunter College Athletics
cards.access_notes: The mascot appears at home games in the Sportsplex and during campus celebrations.

cards.title: Alumni Hall of Fame Induction
cards.subtitle: Honoring Distinguished Graduates
cards.notes: Plaques in the West Lobby honor alumni who have demonstrated outstanding service and leadership in their fields.
cards.short_summary: A tradition of honoring notable alumni with permanent plaques in the 68th Street campus lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: Inductees are listed by year on plaques in the West Lobby at Hunter's 68th Street campus.
cards.source_title: Major League Umpire, Four Other Luminaries Named to Hunter's Hall of Fame
cards.access_notes: The West Lobby is accessible to students and visitors during building hours.

cards.title: Roosevelt House Student Guides
cards.subtitle: Living History Tradition
cards.notes: Student ambassadors lead tours of the former home of FDR and Eleanor Roosevelt, sharing the family's legacy with the public.
cards.short_summary: A student-led tradition of providing historical tours of the Roosevelt House Public Policy Institute.
cards.evidence_claim: Roosevelt House student guides offer tours to visitors at receptions and special events.
cards.access_notes: Tours are available by appointment or during scheduled public programs at 47-49 East 65th Street.

cards.title: The Final Confetti Drop
cards.subtitle: Graduation Finale
cards.notes: A celebratory tradition at the end of the Barclays Center commencement ceremony where purple and gold confetti falls on graduates.
cards.short_summary: The traditional finale of the Hunter College commencement ceremony involving a large confetti drop.
cards.evidence_claim: Students wait for confetti to fall at the end of the commencement ceremony.
cards.source_title: What even happens during the graduation ceremony? : r/HunterCollege
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually at the end of the spring commencement ceremony at Barclays Center.

cards.title: The Grotesques of Thomas Hunter
cards.subtitle: Architectural Superstition
cards.notes: The Collegiate Gothic facade of Thomas Hunter Hall features numerous stone grotesques that have watched over students since 1911.
cards.short_summary: The historic stone carvings on Thomas Hunter Hall that serve as a unique architectural tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Thomas Hunter Hall features numerous grotesques around its façade, along with cathedral-style windows.
cards.source_title: Grotesque faces staring at you at Hunter College | Ephemeral New York
cards.access_notes: Visible from the sidewalk at 934 Lexington Avenue.

cards.title: The Envoy's 80-Year Legacy
cards.subtitle: Student Journalism Tradition
cards.notes: Since 1944, this student-run publication has served as the primary voice for campus news and culture.
cards.short_summary: The long-standing tradition of student-led journalism at Hunter College through The Envoy.
cards.evidence_claim: Since 1944, The Envoy has served as Hunter College's student-run publication.
cards.source_title: Publications and Media - Hunter College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: The publication is distributed across campus and available online.

cards.title: New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Official Welcome Ceremony
cards.notes: This required ceremony for freshmen and transfers marks the formal entry into the Hunter academic community each semester.
cards.short_summary: The official welcoming ritual for all new students entering Hunter College.
cards.evidence_claim: New Student Convocation is the official welcome ceremony and celebration exclusively for new students.
cards.source_title: New Student Convocation - Hunter College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Held at the start of each semester; invitations are sent to student emails.
